_howto: This file drives the in-game Events panel. Edit it, commit, push — the site auto-deploys and
the game picks it up within ~5 minutes. NO client build is needed for anything in here.
events[]  — same shape as the game's data/events.json. Fields:
id          required, unique. Reusing a bundled id OVERRIDES that bundled event.
name        title on the card
blurb       one line shown on the card

description full text in the detail view ( 

 between paragraphs )
time        descriptive schedule line, e.g. 'Sat & Sun - 3 sessions daily'
color       hex, used for the card gradient when there is no hero art
hidden      true retires an event, including a bundled one
runs        {"from":"YYYY-MM-DD","to":"YYYY-MM-DD"} - show the card ONLY in that
window. UTC, and 'to' is EXCLUSIVE so consecutive weeks hand over with no
gap. This is how a multi-week ROTATION is published in one push: give every
week's card its own dates up front and never touch the feed again.
Not the same as 'schedule' (day-of-week recurrence, e.g. every Saturday) -
a card may carry both. Omit it and the card is always visible.
Hero art is OPTIONAL and must ship in the build (assets/sprites/events/event_<id>.png).
Without it the card falls back to the colour gradient. Art ALREADY SHIPS for these ids,
so reusing one gets a banner with no build: sanctum_rush_hour, exp_rush, playtime_wings,
supporter_chest. Any other id shows the gradient, which is why 'color' always matters.
patch_notes[] — rows in the panel's Patch Notes section, newest first. Each opens 'url' in
the player's browser. Only list versions that actually have a page on the site.

events.name: EXP Rush Hour
events.blurb: x2 EXP in three daily windows — and x4 while Eloria's Favor is active.
events.description:
Three times a day, for three hours at a time, every kill earns DOUBLE EXP.

It stacks with Eloria's Favor: keep Favor active during a window and each kill grants x4 EXP instead of the usual x3.

The times above are shown in your own timezone, with a countdown to the next one. A banner appears at the top of your screen while a window is open.

events.name: Guild Contribution ×2
events.time: This week · all week, every hour
events.blurb: Every Guild Order you finish is worth double contribution.
events.description:
All week, completing a Guild Order awards DOUBLE contribution — to your own Grade and to your guild's pool.

Your daily ceiling doubles with it, so the extra points are real rather than being swallowed by the cap. Five orders a day, twice the value — and unlike the other weeks this one runs around the clock, so it never matters what hour you play.

The best week of the month to push a Grade, or to bank the pool toward a guild buff. Bring your guild.

events.name: Collector's Week
events.blurb: Collection and crafting materials drop at double rate, three times a day.
events.description:
Three times a day, for three hours at a time, every collection material and every crafting material drops at DOUBLE its usual rate.

This is the week to close out a Collection you have been chipping away at, or to bank materials before the next upgrade push. The Monsterpedia will tell you which monster drops what, and where to find it.

The times above are shown in your own timezone, with a countdown to the next window.

events.name: Forge Week
events.blurb: Sunderite and Elorite drop at double rate, three times a day.
events.description:
Three times a day, for three hours at a time, Sunderite and Elorite — the materials that carry your gear upgrades — drop at DOUBLE their usual rate.

Upgrade materials are the real ceiling on gear progress, so these are the windows to stockpile in and push a piece further than you normally could. The bonus applies in every zone they drop.

The times above are shown in your own timezone, with a countdown to the next window.
